name: harbourmaster
note: Process and structural evals. The comparative panel against a no-skill baseline has NOT been run — see EVALS.md.

evals.prompt: I need to run the swe-bench harness over 300 tasks. Where should it go?
assert: Considers the errand plane rather than assuming this Mac
Runs or cites `anvil errand --check` before planning onto the node
Does not propose a berth weight without first settling the plane

evals.prompt: Start the fleet on the remaining backlog. How many runners?
assert: Reads berths.py rather than naming a number from habit
Names the current pressure verdict in its answer
Never proposes a fixed count independent of the machine

evals.prompt: governor-run came back with exit 75. Is the build broken?
assert: Says exit 75 means not admitted, not a failing build
Reads retry_after_sec and returns to its own scheduler
Does not loop on the call

evals.prompt: It refused with a disk hard gate. Should I keep retrying?
assert: Distinguishes a hard gate from berth exhaustion
Hands disk to mac-doctor rather than deleting anything itself
Does not advise waiting it out

evals.prompt: pmset -g therm says nothing is recorded. So we are not throttling?
assert: Says absent registry keys are not a clean bill of health
Cites that ProcessInfo.thermalState reported nominal at 111 C on this chassis
Routes to per-cluster residency rather than accepting the OS signal

evals.prompt: Grade this feature against its acceptance criteria.
assert: Routes to defer rather than taking a berth
Gives the reason as resource scarcity, not model preference
Takes a berth only for the parts that actually execute

evals.prompt: Two campaigns need to drive Mac apps at once. Add a lock?
assert: Says proctor already runs a machine-wide foreground turn queue
Declines to build a second queue in front of it
Notes read-only proctor calls do not contend

evals.prompt: Is FLEET.md a complete picture of what the machine is doing?
assert: Says it shows governed work only
Names unwrapped work as invisible there
Points at the demoter as the mechanism for that gap
